name: Halo: Combat Evolved (MCC)

scale.why: Master Chief stands 70.127 HEK (3ds Max) units = 0.70127 world units (100 HEK units per WU), scaled to 1.8 m: 2.567 m/WU

speed.note: backward / strafe 2.0 WU/s; conversion assumes 100 HEK units per world unit

grapple.note: no grapple (Halo Infinite adds the Grappleshot)

jumpReach.source: https://nikon.bungie.org/misc/hek_tutorial/references/general/halo_player_stats.html (standing jump clears 80 HEK units; crouch jump 99)
jumpReach.note: the highest ledge cleared, not the take-off speed

extras: slow, floaty jumps relative to the body
notes: From the Halo Editing Kit reference. Gravity and acceleration aren't listed.
